tool_args.command:
mkdir -p /root/occsafe_vla/scripts/ && cat > /root/occsafe_vla/scripts/monitor_training.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# monitor_training.sh — 轻量训练进程监控
LOG=/tmp/training_monitor.log
INTERVAL=600

while true; do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    GPU_PROCS=$(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    
    if [ "$GPU_PROCS" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] TRAINING_DONE — 0 GPU processes detected" >> $LOG
    else
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] TRAINING_ACTIVE — $GPU_PROCS GPU processes" >> $LOG
    fi
    
    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader >> $LOG
    echo "---" >> $LOG
    
    sleep $INTERVAL
done
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/occsafe_vla/scripts/monitor_training.sh && pkill -f monitor_training.sh 2>/dev/null; > /tmp/training_monitor.log && nohup bash /root/occsafe_vla/scripts/monitor_training.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo "Monitor PID: $!" && sleep 5 && cat /tmp/training_monitor.log
